June 12, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.96% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc bought 1,812 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 32,220 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.41M, up from 30,408 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $943.46 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $191.95. About 10.69M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending.
